summary: First launch on a fresh support folder: the Quota Widget appears, centred on the main display's right edge, within 2 s of the menu-bar icon, collapsed to its strip (auto-collapse is on by default, D56).
review: Menu-bar crop shows the status icon; the widget capture shows the collapsed strip, centred on the edge. The machine time runs from subject registration and includes probe latency, so a value above 2 s is REVIEW, not FAIL.
